mechanism: Contiguous exceedance dwell bank (current run, running-max run, episode count, gap)
core_idea: Length of the CURRENT contiguous excursion of the AR-residual scale outside the per-series historical null band, and its running maximum
closest_prior_experiment: m01_seq::_per (cumulative FRACTION above q99); m10_persist (W5-E2 REJECTED, -0.00041 vs seed clone)
why_not_equivalent: _per cannot distinguish scattered from contiguous exceedances; m10_persist aimed at outlier-vs-bulk AMPLITUDE, never a running-max dwell with a matched-length run null
leakage_risk: low - path functional of online[:t+1] and history only
dominant_cell_relevance: VERY HIGH - measured 0.608 fold-0 cell AUC standalone; 0.613 vs never-break negatives
expected_redundancy: LOW - within-t rho 0.367 with the RT600 blend (lowest measured in this project)
cheapest_pilot: MODE A block <=24 cols, ABL protocol fold 0, control = RT-303 seed clone AND RT-740 (m10_persist)
kill_criterion: cand-clone < +0.0010, or the gain concentrates below age 50 (smoothing signature)

mechanism: Run-length / path-functional null calibration
core_idea: Empirical distribution of length-matched run maxima over the historical segment, exactly as NullCal does for rolling means
closest_prior_experiment: sbr.nullcal (rolling-mean nulls); m01_seq::_Chan (detector-path LEVEL nulls incl. dyadic running-peak)
why_not_equivalent: _Chan nulls the running peak LEVEL, never the running DURATION; no path-length functional has a null anywhere in the repo
dominant_cell_relevance: VERY HIGH - D6 shows the naive extreme-value normalisation FAILS (0.580 vs 0.608), so this is the required fix
kill_criterion: if calibrated dwell does not beat raw dwell, keep raw and drop the layer

mechanism: Excursion mass (area above band since last re-entry) and its running max
core_idea: Integrated excess over the null band, reset on re-entry
why_not_equivalent: decayed peak never resets on re-entry; the area-since-re-entry has no analogue

mechanism: Contiguity ratio (longest run / total exceedance count)
sources: Erdos-Renyi 1970; Gordon-Schilling-Waterman 1986; Amarioarei-Preda 2020 (scan stats); this repo: research/reports/new_avenues_2026_diagnostics.json (D1-D6)
core_idea: Explicit scattered-vs-sustained discriminator at matched exceedance load
why_not_equivalent: the ratio of the two is a difference-of-features boosters approximate badly (the same argument that motivated m10_persist's *_gap)
dominant_cell_relevance: VERY HIGH - directly separates heavy-tailed stable series (E.2 population) from real breaks

mechanism: Excursion growth exponent d log(maxrun)/d log t
sources: Erdos-Renyi 1970; Gordon-Schilling-Waterman 1986; Amarioarei-Preda 2020 (scan stats); this repo: research/reports/new_avenues_2026_diagnostics.json (D1-D6)
core_idea: Under stationarity the longest run grows like log t; under a persistent break it grows like t. Emit the online estimate of the exponent
why_not_equivalent: no column anywhere estimates a growth rate of any path functional
dominant_cell_relevance: VERY HIGH - E.4 measures never-break p90 rising 56->94 while mature-break p90 rises 94->239 over the same t range

mechanism: Re-entry / recovery statistics (returns to band, recovery time, re-entry hazard)
core_idea: Empirical hazard of returning to the null band given current deviation size and dwell
why_not_equivalent: no reversion/recovery functional exists
cheapest_pilot: fold into Pilot 1 as a second variant if budget allows

mechanism: Multi-threshold time-over-threshold profile (q75/q90/q99 run vector)
sources: IEEE Std C37.112-2018/1996; Erdos-Renyi 1970; Gordon-Schilling-Waterman 1986; Amarioarei-Preda 2020 (scan stats)
core_idea: The relay time-current curve analogue in evidence space
why_not_equivalent: one threshold vs a profile; the profile shape is the transient-vs-permanent signature

mechanism: IEEE C37.112 inverse-time operate integral + reset integral
core_idea: Integrate dt/T(M) while evidence exceeds pickup; integrate the standardised RESET characteristic while it does not
closest_prior_experiment: apply_persistence runmax (-0.0060) / decaymax (-0.0033..+0.0005) / EWMA (+0.0005) on the final score
why_not_equivalent: measured transforms are symmetric or monotone on the SCORE; C37.112 defines a two-integral state machine with an explicit reset, applied to EVIDENCE channels
expected_runtime: TINY - the F arm is pure post-processing on existing OOF arrays
dominant_cell_relevance: HIGH - acts directly on the dominant cell's score
expected_redundancy: MODERATE for the F arm; LOW-MODERATE for the A arm
cheapest_pilot: Pilot 2: F arm first (35 min), A arm only if F shows life
kill_criterion: F arm inside +/-0.0005 of the measured EWMA result => no new state => KILL

mechanism: Thermal-replica I2t accumulator with asymmetric charge/cool time constants
core_idea: Charge fast while above pickup, cool 4x slower - hysteresis by construction
why_not_equivalent: single symmetric half-life cannot express charge/cool asymmetry

mechanism: Auto-recloser cycle count (pickup->reset cycles)
core_idea: A permanent fault re-trips after every reclose; a transient does not. Count complete pickup->reset cycles
why_not_equivalent: no reset event is counted anywhere
dominant_cell_relevance: HIGH - counts EPISODES, the exact quantity distinguishing scattered from sustained

mechanism: Two-stage coordination (low-pickup/long-delay + high-pickup/short-delay)
core_idea: Emit both accumulators so the model can read fast-large and slow-small evidence separately
why_not_equivalent: EWMA half-lives vary the smoothing, not the threshold/delay pairing

mechanism: Pickup/dropout hysteresis (Schmitt trigger, dropout ratio < 1)
core_idea: State flips up at pickup and down only below a strictly lower dropout - single points cannot flip it
why_not_equivalent: every incumbent threshold is a single level

mechanism: Arc-fault-style high-band persistence with reset
core_idea: Fraction of recent windows whose high-band energy ratio exceeded the historical band, with relay-style reset
why_not_equivalent: band power level vs persistence-with-reset of band power

mechanism: Hankel-DMD observer: frozen historical operator, reconstruction residual + effective rank
sources: Gottwald & Gugole, J Stat Phys 2019; arXiv:2405.15576; arXiv:2407.05976
core_idea: Transients explore the full state space with fast relaxation; equilibrium evolves on a lower-dimensional attractor. Monitor h-step reconstruction residual and online effective rank
closest_prior_experiment: m04_resid AR(1/2/5)/ridge/Huber (scalar one-step); m12_rdep AR-coefficient LR
why_not_equivalent: all incumbents are SCALAR ONE-STEP predictors; no delay-embedded operator and NO effective-rank analogue exists anywhere
leakage_risk: low - operator frozen on history, never refit online
cheapest_pilot: Pilot 3 arm (b), fold 0, control = seed clone + m04_resid-only ablation

mechanism: Kalman NIS + innovation whiteness against a NON-ADAPTIVE history-fitted state space
sources: Bar-Shalom et al. 2001 (NIS); Online tests of Kalman filter consistency; modified whiteness test for damage detection
core_idea: Normalized innovation squared accumulated against its chi-square expectation, plus Ljung-Box whiteness of the innovation sequence
closest_prior_experiment: m04_resid Gaussian GLR channel mean(e^2)-log var(e)-1; m04_resid GARCH(1,1) = 0.50012 (chance)
why_not_equivalent: the GLR is a static LR on a fixed whitening; NIS normalises by the FILTER'S OWN predicted covariance and whiteness is a separate functional. The GARCH failure is the in-repo proof the filter must NOT adapt
leakage_risk: low - parameters fixed on history by a deterministic grid

mechanism: Observer bank / MMAE over disjoint historical blocks
sources: Bar-Shalom et al. 2001 (NIS); Online tests of Kalman filter consistency; modified whiteness test for damage detection
core_idea: Fit K models on K disjoint historical blocks; online, track the posterior over which block explains the data. Posterior drift is the break signal
closest_prior_experiment: m05_ctx (rejected as features); DGP-cluster gating (-0.0219 full scale)
why_not_equivalent: both prior attempts partitioned SERIES ACROSS THE DATASET and data-starved the specialists; this partitions HISTORY WITHIN ONE SERIES and never splits training data

mechanism: Unknown-input-observer analogue (residual decoupled from the dominant historical mode)
sources: Bar-Shalom et al. 2001 (NIS); Online tests of Kalman filter consistency; modified whiteness test for damage detection
core_idea: Design the residual generator to be insensitive to the series' own dominant mode so it responds only to NEW structure
why_not_equivalent: whitening removes predictable dynamics; decoupling removes a SPECIFIC mode and keeps the rest

mechanism: Conditional-quantile (quantile-AR) null and per-quantile online coverage
sources: Ramdas-Grunwald-Vovk-Shafer, Stat Sci 2023; Vovk 2021; arXiv:1706.03415; arXiv:2505.04608 (WCTM); Choe & Ramdas adjusters
core_idea: Fit historical conditional quantile functions; monitor online conditional coverage per quantile
why_not_equivalent: the incumbent PIT is unconditional; conditional coverage sees a break that changes the predictive law at fixed marginal

mechanism: Reservoir / random-feature nonlinear AR null fitted on history
sources: Gottwald & Gugole, J Stat Phys 2019; arXiv:2405.15576; arXiv:2407.05976
core_idea: The cheap non-neural nonlinear system-ID: fixed random recurrent features, linear readout fitted on history, residual monitored online
closest_prior_experiment: W6-N2 causal TCN (0.5432, failed both bars)
why_not_equivalent: the TCN LEARNED a representation across series; this fits a per-series readout on that series' own history - a null model, not a classifier
cheapest_pilot: only if C1/C2 show residual-space life

mechanism: Block-bootstrap historical null for any statistic
core_idea: Repairs NullCal's implicit independent-window assumption for strongly dependent series
why_not_equivalent: contiguous windows already carry dependence but the SAMPLE SIZE of the null is inflated; a block bootstrap prices the effective sample size
dominant_cell_relevance: MODERATE - directly relevant to the long-memory never-break population (E.2)
kill_criterion: no measurable change vs the incumbent null

mechanism: Explicit-duration (semi-Markov) run-length prior in BOCPD
sources: Bulla & Bulla CSDA 2010; CSDA 2025 (inhomogeneous dwell); arXiv:2105.11490
core_idea: Replace the geometric hazard with an explicit dwell-time distribution so the run-length posterior can express persistence
closest_prior_experiment: m07_bayes BOCPD (geometric hazard) and absorbing-state posterior (geometric h)
why_not_equivalent: both impose a memoryless dwell whose modal duration is one step - exactly the limitation HSMMs exist to fix

mechanism: Reversion hazard from history (P(return | size s, dwell d))
sources: Erdos-Renyi 1970; Gordon-Schilling-Waterman 1986; Amarioarei-Preda 2020 (scan stats); Bulla & Bulla CSDA 2010; CSDA 2025 (inhomogeneous dwell); arXiv:2105.11490
core_idea: Estimate from the historical segment the hazard of returning to the null band and score the online state's survival
why_not_equivalent: no hazard/survival functional exists

mechanism: Two-state dwell ratio with hysteresis
core_idea: Fraction of the last L steps in the deviated state, at several L, with a Schmitt trigger so single points cannot flip it
why_not_equivalent: the hysteresis is what makes it robust to the heavy-tailed negatives

mechanism: Trapping time / laminarity from a causal recurrence plot
sources: Marwan et al., Physics Reports 438 (2007); arXiv:2409.04110; arXiv:2101.10136
core_idea: Vertical structures in a recurrence plot give laminarity and trapping time - the average time the system spends in a state
why_not_equivalent: no recurrence structure exists in the repository

mechanism: Metastability / Kramers escape rate from a historical effective potential
sources: Scheffer et al. Nature 2009; Dakos et al. Ecology 2012; Lenton et al. Phil Trans A 2012
core_idea: Fit a 1-D effective potential from the historical empirical density; compute the escape rate from the historical basin and the online residence time in a new basin
why_not_equivalent: the bank has no notion of a basin or a potential

mechanism: Scale-survival count and coarsest surviving scale
core_idea: At how many increasing temporal scales is the current state still outside the per-series null band?
closest_prior_experiment: m00_core six trailing windows; m03_dyn Haar energies
why_not_equivalent: the bank emits each scale and lets LightGBM combine them; it never emits the COUNT of surviving scales
cheapest_pilot: Pilot 5, control = an arm adding the per-scale surprises individually
kill_criterion: cand-clone < +0.0010 or the individual-scale arm matches the summary arm

mechanism: Renormalisation coarse-graining decay exponent
core_idea: Block-average by factor b; a break survives coarse-graining, an outlier does not. Emit the decay exponent of evidence in b
why_not_equivalent: window length is not the same as block-averaging the stream then re-nulling at the coarse scale

mechanism: Time-causal scale-space cascade; scale at which evidence peaks
core_idea: Cascade of truncated-exponential smoothers; emit the peak scale and whether it is growing
why_not_equivalent: the peak scale as a moving quantity is not emitted

mechanism: Wavelet-modulus-maxima line persistence across scales
core_idea: A maximum that survives to coarse scales is a discontinuity; one that dies is noise
why_not_equivalent: energy per scale vs the persistence of a maxima LINE across scales

mechanism: MFDFA multifractal spectrum width change
core_idea: Change in the width of the multifractal spectrum between history and online
why_not_equivalent: DFA in m05_ctx was a static context column; the online spectrum-width CHANGE is a detector

mechanism: Spectral kurtosis impulsiveness contrast (energy_z x -SK_z)
sources: Antoni MSSP 2006; Wang et al. MSSP 2015; arXiv:2502.07478
core_idea: Band excess energy with LOW spectral kurtosis = sustained regime change; the same energy with HIGH kurtosis = outlier burst
closest_prior_experiment: m03_dyn band powers, spectral entropy, slope, dominant frequency
why_not_equivalent: impulsiveness is measured nowhere; the kurtogram's documented blindness to repetition rate is exactly the contrast we want
kill_criterion: cand-clone < +0.0010 or the contrast column carries less gain than plain energy

mechanism: Envelope-spectrum negentropy (heavy-tail-robust impulsiveness)
sources: Antoni MSSP 2006; Wang et al. MSSP 2015; arXiv:2502.07478
core_idea: Negentropy replaces kurtosis where the background is non-Gaussian - exactly our heavy-tailed never-break population
why_not_equivalent: kurtosis-based measures are dominated by single points in heavy-tailed series; that is the E.2 failure population

mechanism: AR pole migration (modulus and argument drift vs historical poles)
sources: Gottwald & Gugole, J Stat Phys 2019; arXiv:2405.15576; arXiv:2407.05976
core_idea: Roots of the online-refit AR polynomial vs the historical poles
why_not_equivalent: the LR is a scalar test of coefficient change; pole modulus vs argument separates a PERSISTENCE change from a FREQUENCY change, which the LR cannot

mechanism: Split-window spectral coherence (first vs second half of the online window)
sources: Antoni MSSP 2006; Wang et al. MSSP 2015; arXiv:2502.07478
core_idea: Coherence between the two halves of the online window, nulled against its historical distribution
why_not_equivalent: a spectrum vs the STABILITY of that spectrum inside the window

mechanism: Cyclostationarity: cyclic autocovariance / envelope-spectrum change
sources: Antoni MSSP 2006; Wang et al. MSSP 2015; arXiv:2502.07478
core_idea: Second-order cyclostationary content vs the historical null
why_not_equivalent: no cyclic statistic exists
dominant_cell_relevance: LOW-MODERATE (needs a hidden period, unlikely in this DGP family)
cheapest_pilot: not queued unless F1 shows life

mechanism: Cepstral / envelope statistics
sources: Antoni MSSP 2006; Wang et al. MSSP 2015; arXiv:2502.07478
core_idea: Cepstral coefficients of the online window vs history
why_not_equivalent: log-spectrum quefrency structure is a different basis

mechanism: FLOSS arc-crossing curve with history as the reference half
sources: Gharghabi et al. ICDM 2017 / DMKD 2019 (Matrix Profile VIII, FLUSS/FLOSS); Yeh et al. ICDM 2016
core_idea: Count nearest-neighbour arcs crossing the history/online boundary; few crossings => high probability of a semantic regime change
closest_prior_experiment: m06_loc, m11_focus (both localise via SEGMENT STATISTICS)
why_not_equivalent: localisation is not similarity; nothing in 500 columns compares shapes
leakage_risk: low - subsequence index built on history only
dominant_cell_relevance: HIGH; also the cheapest test of brief section 44 (is temporal order lost)
cheapest_pilot: Pilot 4, control = seed clone AND a shuffled-history control
kill_criterion: cand-clone < +0.0010, or the shuffled-history control matches the real one

mechanism: Nearest-neighbour provenance ratio (history vs recent-online neighbours)
sources: Gharghabi et al. ICDM 2017 / DMKD 2019 (Matrix Profile VIII, FLUSS/FLOSS); Yeh et al. ICDM 2016
core_idea: For the current window, what fraction of its k nearest neighbours live in history vs in the recent online segment?
why_not_equivalent: no similarity statistic exists anywhere

mechanism: Matrix-profile distance from online subsequences to the historical subsequence set
sources: Gharghabi et al. ICDM 2017 / DMKD 2019 (Matrix Profile VIII, FLUSS/FLOSS); Yeh et al. ICDM 2016
core_idea: Minimum distance to the historical subsequence set = shape novelty; emit its running statistics
why_not_equivalent: no shape distance exists

mechanism: Delay-embedded attractor separation (energy / Wasserstein distance between point clouds)
sources: Marwan et al., Physics Reports 438 (2007); arXiv:2409.04110; arXiv:2101.10136; Perea & Harer, FoCM 2015 (SW1PerS)
core_idea: Multivariate distance between the historical and online delay-embedded point clouds
closest_prior_experiment: m02_dist energy distance / Wasserstein on the 1-D PIT; m12_rdep the same on residuals
why_not_equivalent: every incumbent distance is on the MARGINAL (1-D); the delay-embedded cloud is joint over d lags

mechanism: RQA recurrence rate / determinism / divergence vs a history-fixed threshold
sources: Marwan et al., Physics Reports 438 (2007); arXiv:2409.04110; arXiv:2101.10136
core_idea: Diagonal-structure recurrence measures against a threshold fixed on history
why_not_equivalent: no recurrence structure exists

mechanism: Sliding-window persistent homology max-persistence change (SW1PerS)
core_idea: Change in maximum persistence of the sliding-window embedding between history and online
why_not_equivalent: no topological statistic exists

mechanism: Weighted conformal test martingale (benign-shift-robust betting)
sources: Ramdas-Grunwald-Vovk-Shafer, Stat Sci 2023; Vovk 2021; arXiv:1706.03415; arXiv:2505.04608 (WCTM); Choe & Ramdas adjusters
core_idea: Weight the betting function to be insensitive to benign heavy-tail excursions while remaining sensitive to persistent shift
closest_prior_experiment: m07_bayes e-processes incl. plug-in GRAPA, mixture betting and Vovk's power martingale on conformal p-values
why_not_equivalent: the incumbent bets against a FIXED null; the weighting is the 2025 extension and targets exactly the E.2 heavy-tail population
dominant_cell_relevance: HIGH for the never-break population specifically
cheapest_pilot: Pilot 8, control = the UNWEIGHTED conformal martingale m07_bayes already ships
kill_criterion: cand-clone < +0.0010, or the weighted arm does not beat the unweighted arm in the never-break split

mechanism: E-value calculus aggregation (averaging / adjusters) as a parameter-free 8th specialist
sources: Ramdas-Grunwald-Vovk-Shafer, Stat Sci 2023; Vovk 2021; arXiv:1706.03415; arXiv:2505.04608 (WCTM); Choe & Ramdas adjusters
core_idea: Combine per-channel e-processes by a valid e-value merge instead of by LightGBM
closest_prior_experiment: 7-specialist equal-weight SCDF mean; LOFO logistic/LightGBM stacks (both lose)
why_not_equivalent: a different COMBINATION RULE with no fitted parameters - and the project has established every learned combination loses to the equal mean
expected_redundancy: HIGH - re-combines information the ensemble already has

mechanism: Sequential kernel MMD vs the historical sample, scanned over window lengths
sources: Ramdas-Grunwald-Vovk-Shafer, Stat Sci 2023; Vovk 2021; arXiv:1706.03415; arXiv:2505.04608 (WCTM); Choe & Ramdas adjusters
core_idea: Two-sample MMD between the online window and the historical sample, maximised over window length
closest_prior_experiment: m02_dist energy distance (a special case of MMD with the distance kernel)
why_not_equivalent: energy distance IS an MMD special case - this is only new if a characteristic kernel on DELAY VECTORS is used, i.e. it collapses into G5
expected_redundancy: HIGH - largely redundant with m02_dist unless multivariate
cheapest_pilot: merge into G5 rather than running separately

mechanism: Conformal prediction-interval coverage stream (coverage collapse + width inflation)
sources: Ramdas-Grunwald-Vovk-Shafer, Stat Sci 2023; Vovk 2021; arXiv:1706.03415; arXiv:2505.04608 (WCTM); Choe & Ramdas adjusters
core_idea: Fit a conformal predictor on history; monitor online empirical coverage and interval width as two channels
why_not_equivalent: PIT occupancy is unconditional; conformal coverage of a PREDICTIVE interval is conditional on the fitted predictor

mechanism: Rank CvM / Anderson-Darling with an explicit run-length component
core_idea: Combine a rank distance with the run structure of its exceedances
why_not_equivalent: the rejected family was rank statistics ALONE; the run component is the new part and is Pilot 1's channel in rank space

mechanism: Joint (size x duration) rarity: -log P(|dev| >= s AND duration >= d)
core_idea: Empirical 2-D historical table over (threshold, duration); score the live excursion and the running-max excursion
closest_prior_experiment: m00_core::surprise (magnitude at fixed length); m11_focus max over tau
why_not_equivalent: every incumbent surprise prices magnitude at fixed length or length at fixed magnitude; nothing prices the JOINT event
dominant_cell_relevance: VERY HIGH - the formal statement of the E.4 finding
cheapest_pilot: Pilot 10, control = seed clone AND Pilot 1's own dwell columns
kill_criterion: cand-clone < +0.0010, or I1 <= A1 on the dominant cell

mechanism: Record statistics (new historical-scale records vs log-growth under stationarity)
core_idea: Under stationarity the expected number of records grows like log n; count the online excess
why_not_equivalent: running peak is a LEVEL; the COUNT of records and its deviation from log n is a different functional

mechanism: Scan statistic over (start,length) with the exact historical null of the maximum
core_idea: Maximise over both endpoints and price the multiple testing per series from history
closest_prior_experiment: m11_focus (exact max over tau, calibrated by restart positions on history)
why_not_equivalent: m11_focus maximises over ONE endpoint (tau to t); a full (start,length) scan is a strictly larger family, but the marginal value over m11_focus is likely small
expected_redundancy: HIGH - m11_focus already does most of this

mechanism: Cramer rate function of the block mean estimated from history
core_idea: Estimate the rate function from the historical cumulant generating function; score = rate x block length
why_not_equivalent: an empirical p-value floors at 1/2m; the rate function extrapolates into the tail where the empirical null has no mass - which is exactly where mature breaks live

mechanism: Scalar historical difficulty gate (one OOF-trained column)
core_idea: One history-only scalar, OOF-trained to predict RT-600's own dominant-cell loss rate, used as a single interaction column
closest_prior_experiment: m05_ctx 50 raw series-constant columns (-0.0177 full scale; permutation control -0.057)
why_not_equivalent: the failure was ENCODING - 50 near-continuous series-constant columns let LightGBM memorise series identity. One OOF scalar with a derangement control cannot. Substrate confirmed: OOF Spearman +0.192 vs permutation -0.031
leakage_risk: MEDIUM - must carry the within-fold derangement control that caught m05_ctx
expected_redundancy: UNKNOWN - worth measuring precisely because unknown
cheapest_pilot: Pilot 9 part (i), control = seed clone AND within-fold derangement
kill_criterion: derangement control not clearly worse => memorisation => KILL immediately; else cand-clone < +0.0010

mechanism: Specialist-competence-by-fingerprint diagnostic
core_idea: Does which of the seven specialists wins vary by historical fingerprint quintile, beyond a permuted-fingerprint control?
why_not_equivalent: the rejected experiment RETRAINED specialists per cluster and data-starved them; this measures the competence of the EXISTING seven and would only reweight
expected_runtime: TINY - seven OOF vectors and the fingerprint bank are already on disk
kill_criterion: argmax specialist does not vary more than the permuted control => Family J routing is dead

mechanism: Tail-index-conditioned null (GPD/Hill fit replaces empirical quantiles)
core_idea: Set the exceedance thresholds from a fitted tail rather than an empirical quantile, so heavy-tailed series are not systematically over-flagged
why_not_equivalent: FAILED_EXPERIMENTS.md names this EXACT retry as the untested alternative: condition the null on the series' own tail index rather than sharpening the online statistic
dominant_cell_relevance: HIGH - directly targets the E.2 heavy-tail false-positive population

mechanism: Effective-sample-size correction (divide z by sqrt(ESS) from the historical ACF)
core_idea: A long-memory series has far fewer independent online observations than its length suggests; discount its evidence accordingly
why_not_equivalent: the empirical null inherits dependence in its SPREAD but the null SAMPLE SIZE is still inflated; an explicit ESS divisor is a different correction

mechanism: Per-series conformal p-value transform before ranking
sources: Ramdas-Grunwald-Vovk-Shafer, Stat Sci 2023; Vovk 2021; arXiv:1706.03415; arXiv:2505.04608 (WCTM); Choe & Ramdas adjusters
core_idea: Convert each series' evidence into a p-value against its own null, then rank - a legal approximation of the illegal within-t cross-sectional rank
closest_prior_experiment: RT-131 within-timestep rank oracle (ILLEGAL); SCDF time-conditional calibration (shipped)
why_not_equivalent: SCDF calibrates against the TRAINING cross-section at matched t; this calibrates against the SERIES' OWN null - a different reference
expected_redundancy: HIGH - the calibration layer already does most of this
cheapest_pilot: not queued unless K5 shows life

mechanism: Error-manifold clustering on the per-series loss cube x fingerprint
core_idea: Are there two or more distinct failure manifolds, or one diffuse one?
why_not_equivalent: W5-D2 profiled the top 1% of false positives; this decomposes the EXACT metric loss per series (D1) and clusters it
expected_runtime: SMALL - the D1 loss cube is already on disk
dominant_cell_relevance: HIGH - decides whether targeted repair is viable at all
kill_criterion: clusters do not separate beyond a permutation control => Family K is dead

mechanism: Density-ratio repair over the WHOLE cell (no confidence threshold)
core_idea: Learn P(RT600 wrong)/P(RT600 right) over the entire dominant cell rather than mining a confident subset
why_not_equivalent: ORR's mechanism was real and its COVERAGE was fatal (D.5); E.1 measures that the loss is diffuse (worst 10% of never-break series hold only 27.7%), so full coverage is the only viable form
leakage_risk: MEDIUM - must be nested outer-fold-pure like RT-994/995
expected_redundancy: MODERATE-HIGH (it is a function of RT600's own score)

mechanism: Specialist within-t rank spread (disagreement) as an input channel
core_idea: The seven specialists' disagreement at a given (series,t) is itself information about evidence validity
closest_prior_experiment: none - the blend averages and discards the spread
why_not_equivalent: the spread is thrown away by the equal-weight mean
leakage_risk: MEDIUM - must be cross-fitted exactly like the blend
expected_redundancy: HIGH - derived entirely from RT600's own members

mechanism: Negative-only specialist (rank negatives by break-likeness, applied subtractively)
core_idea: A model trained only to separate hard negatives from easy ones, used as a correction
why_not_equivalent: the curriculum REWEIGHTED training; this trains a separate head on a different target

mechanism: Two-population calibration (separate SCDF anchors by tail index)
core_idea: Fit the time-conditional CDF separately for heavy- and light-tailed series
why_not_equivalent: the calibration family was chosen by nested CV but never conditioned on a series property
leakage_risk: MEDIUM - adds fitted parameters to a frozen, parameter-free layer
kill_criterion: cand-clone < +0.0010; and it must beat a RANDOM two-way split of the same size

mechanism: Ordinal transition-matrix divergence
sources: Bandt & Pompe PRL 2002; Ramsey & Rothman JMCB 1996
core_idea: KL divergence of the online order-3 ordinal transition matrix from the historical one, nulled at matched count
why_not_equivalent: entropy is a scalar summary of the ordinal DISTRIBUTION; the TRANSITION matrix is a different object and survives changes that leave entropy fixed
cheapest_pilot: Pilot 7, control = seed clone AND a permutation-entropy-only arm

mechanism: Time irreversibility (Ramsey-Rothman / visibility-graph asymmetry)
sources: Bandt & Pompe PRL 2002; Ramsey & Rothman JMCB 1996
core_idea: Time-reversal asymmetry of the online segment vs its historical null

why_not_equivalent: the incumbent conditions on time only; adding a path variable is a genuinely larger family

why_not_equivalent: asymmetry is the only new part; close to the measured family

core_idea: First and second differences of the calibrated score in log t

expected_runtime: MEDIUM (requires replaying the model on history)

mechanism: Post-transition relaxation rate (AR(1) recovery settling at a new level)
sources: Scheffer et al. Nature 2009; Dakos et al. Ecology 2012; Lenton et al. Phil Trans A 2012
core_idea: Critical slowing down inverted: a real regime change RESETS the relaxation rate to a new stable value; a transient spikes and returns
why_not_equivalent: ACF at a window is a LEVEL; the RATE OF RETURN TO BASELINE after a perturbation is a conditional functional. NOTE: the source's own use is PRE-transition warning, which under y[t]=1[t>=tau] would HURT - the inversion is our inference, not the literature's
leakage_risk: MEDIUM - a pre-break signal would raise pre-break negatives and hurt; must be checked in the pre-break split
kill_criterion: cand-clone < +0.0010, or the pre-break-negative split gets worse
